card.name: Scattered mid-sentence words in drug text
card.fires_on: No single word or setting fits. It marks varied words such as 'potassium', 'as' after 'such', and the middle of words like 'chromosomal' in drug-label text.

modes.label: 'such as' before drug examples
modes.description: The word 'as' after 'such' just before a named example drug.
modes.example: BRONCHOSPASM: A beta 2 -stimulant such<< as>> isoproterenol or terbut

modes.label: Partway through technical words
modes.description: The middle or end of a long science word, like chromosomal or peripherally.

card.plain: It fires on a mix of unrelated words in drug labels, with no single theme a clinician could name.
